title: Same request twice
prompt: Build a 3 by 3 grid of identical squares.

assertions.statement: The first request is one source shape, one duplicator, and one gridDistribution. Nine separate squares fail.
The same prompt is sent again in the same scene, without telling the agent it is a duplicate test. After the second request there is still one duplicator and one source shape.

The current MCP tool list has no upsert, managed-metadata, or scene-graph tool. Passing G2 requires the agent to inspect the open scene and reuse what it finds. Creating a second system and deleting it only after the fact still fails if the transcript shows the duplicate was built.

hypothesis.predicted_unskilled_failure: The second request creates a second grid. The preamble itself says a re-run is not rolled back and duplicates layers.
